description: This class defines a Matrix Builder for creating special matrices such as filled matrices and identity matrices within a PHP project related to matrix operations.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A class providing static methods to create different types of matrices, such as filled matrices and identity matrices.

methods.name: createFilledMatrix
methods.description: Creates a new matrix filled with a specified value, with optional columns parameter for non-square matrices.

methods.name: createIdentityMatrix
methods.description: Creates an identity matrix of the specified dimension, optionally filled with a custom fill value.
